_about: HF105 item B - THE PLATFORM-HELPER PATTERN TABLE (platformHelperDerivation.js). A library registers payloads at runtime from the list each mod hands it: the mod calls a static helper entry (consumer lambda, int version); the helper's listener lambda constructs a registrar object and hands it to the consumer; each registrar method takes the mod's TypeAndCodec and performs the PayloadRegistrar registration. One row per shape; the walk VERIFIES every rule of the row against the helper's bytes (the entry descriptor, the registrar method table, the id rule, the version rule) before a row is claimed - a mismatch abstains by name. Every row cites the fixture jar (real file name + sha1, trimmed test fixture + sha1) and the classes the rules were read from (javap over the real bytes, 2026-10-18). A helper, a mod or a version literal appears ONLY here, never in a code path.

patterns.entry: a static method of that descriptor (reached through same-shaped static forwarders, depth 3) whose body captures the int and the consumer into a listener lambda (desc (I, Consumer, <event>)V) that constructs the registrar class and calls Consumer.accept on it
patterns.registrarMethodTable: READ from the registrar class bytes: every method taking (TypeAndCodec) -> the PayloadRegistrar.play* / configuration* / common* method it invokes (flow + protocols from REGISTRATION_METHODS), optional when PayloadRegistrar.optional() is invoked in that method
patterns.idRuleReads: the registered CustomPacketPayload$Type is the argument's own TypeAndCodec.type() (aload_1; invokevirtual TypeAndCodec.type()); the id is read off the mod's message class static initializer: ldc <path>; invokestatic <mod>.res(String)ResourceLocation (resolveNamespaceHelper) or ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(ns, path) / parse(ns:path); ... putstatic <TypeAndCodec field>
patterns.versionRuleReads: the call site's int constant folded through the listener lambda's makeConcatWithConstants recipe (or String.valueOf(int) / Integer.toString(int)) = the String handed to PayloadRegistrar.versioned(String)
